summary: Rabbi Soffer begins a new Masekhet by exploring the opening Mishna of Arachin, which defines who is obligated to make or be the subject of an Erech vow. He analyzes the use of the word 'Hakol' (everyone) throughout the Mishna and Gemara, using it as a starting point to discuss various halakhic categories and inclusions across Shas.
questions: Who is included in the category of people who can make or be the subject of an Erech vow?
Why does the Mishna use the word 'Hakol' if it later lists exceptions?
Can a person who is disfigured or has no market value still be the subject of an Erech vow?
Does an inheritor have the same obligations regarding S'micha and Temura as the original owner of a Korban?
Are women obligated to hear the Megilla?
